# BDSubMerge 1.0.2-beta.4

This prerelease improves playlist inspection, subtitle offset editing, and application identity.

## Highlights

- Playlist duration, item count, chapter count, and recommendation score now sort by their numeric
  values, so values such as 7, 8, 28, and 62 appear in the expected order.
- Subtitle filename tooltips show the complete filename only instead of exposing the containing
  filesystem path.
- Per-subtitle offset changes invalidate stale preflight results without running preflight after
  every step. Holding either a row-level or batch offset spin button now repeats with acceleration.
- The title bar now shows only `BDSubMerge`. A new About menu links to the project homepage and
  identifies the author as `@YuSaZh` with a non-interactive entry.

## Packages

- Windows x64 ZIP with packaged GUI smoke tests and visual evidence.
- Linux x86_64 tar.gz with native X11 `xcb` startup and visual evidence under Xvfb.
- Both packages contain BDSubMerge's root `LICENSE` without a root `LICENSES` directory.

**Full Changelog**: [v1.0.2-beta.3...v1.0.2-beta.4](https://github.com/YuSaZh/BDSubMerge/compare/v1.0.2-beta.3...v1.0.2-beta.4)
